cause_quote: The new follow-up authority check set `operatorAuthorityLost = true` on any assertion exception, then set `disposition = { kind: "consumed" }`.
user_saw: A message queued in Gateway chat during a temporary access-policy outage was marked withheld and never answered after the policy recovered.
summary: The fix makes authority owners signal revocation and keeps queued messages eligible for retry when an authority check fails without a recorded reason to remove them.
reasoning: #153989 introduced live operator authority for queued follow-ups, consumed input on any assertion exception, and latched revocation found by a direct check without aborting the signal. #198245 made policy evaluation errors recoverable at the authority layer, while the follow-up runner still consumed the message. #200213 surfaced that existing discard as a withheld failure.
